title: facts-program-map-v1

slot_kind.$comment: fixed = take EVERY course in courses[]; choose = pick from courses[] up to credits_required; elective = any course (optionally constrained by rule); placeholder = a 'SUBJ XXXX - choose one' wildcard kept verbatim in courses[]; null = source did not say. Without this the bot cannot tell a required set from an alternatives set.

options_exhaustive.$comment: false when the catalog says 'Other options exist to meet this requirement' (courses[] is then a PARTIAL list -> confirm-with-advisor disclaimer, route-don't-determine); null = not stated

exclusions.$comment: mutually-exclusive course sets ('cannot use BIOL 1406 AND BIOL 1408'); [] when none

courses.$comment: course codes; wildcard/placeholder slots ('MATH XXXX', 'AS General Elective') are stored verbatim with slot_kind=placeholder|elective

$comment: Starter contract (issue #36). Issue #51 finalizes and CI-pins it against the SQLAlchemy models. Nulls mean 'the source didn't say' - never invent values. Evolving a shape = copy to vN+1 and bump schema_version stamps.
